texts.61ea4b60: Where are we playing? Let me look!
texts.9c7aaf59: Which playground are we at? Tap one!
texts.264f847c: Hmm, I don't know that one. Try again!
texts.8b6ab563: You found a tag! Now pick an adventure!
texts.c1905c2e: Tap the big play button to start!
texts.df2bf5aa: Oops! Not this one. You can do it!
texts.e72a736c: Hmm, not quite! Try another spot!
texts.b31267e8: Three in a row! You're on fire!
texts.a41a56d8: Five in a row! Super star!
texts.5f4202a3: Eight in a row! Wow wow wow!
texts.5ae6ed59: Here are your stickers! Play every adventure to collect them all!
texts.0b43d80d: You collected every sticker! You're a Play Quest champion!
texts.016364cf: Pocket mode! Put the phone away and listen for my clues.
texts.0a66bd6e: Oops! Ask a grown-up for help.
texts.08c12fdd: Hmm, I don't know that tag.
texts.dd17f1cc: Hi! I'm Pip, your Play Quest guide!
texts.a7833e9c: Is this Pirate Cove Play Area?
texts.5038c59d: Rescue the Playground Critters! Ten little critters are hiding. Can you find them all?
texts.2aac8afa: Hooray! You did it! You earned the Critter Rescuer badge!
texts.375546f3: Critter Rescuer! You earned this one!
texts.2f715666: Play Rescue the Playground Critters to win this sticker!
texts.ceb88ba3: No critter here. Listen to the clue again!
texts.9a94d694: Power Outage! The lights went out! Run to each power station before the battery runs out!
texts.b5408381: Hooray! You did it! You earned the Power Restorer badge!
texts.b4ccee30: Power Restorer! You earned this one!
texts.3dcce4cb: Play Power Outage to win this sticker!
texts.fc653a85: High and Low Challenge! Go up high, then down low, in just the right order!
texts.4134981f: Hooray! You did it! You earned the High and Low Master badge!
texts.4808fafe: High and Low Master! You earned this one!
texts.bc03e289: Play High and Low Challenge to win this sticker!
texts.379b78dc: The Great Playground Loop! Zoom around one big lap of the playground. Keep moving, don't stop!
texts.9a25d9b5: Hooray! You did it! You earned the Loop Champion badge!
texts.5c13900c: Loop Champion! You earned this one!
texts.d76d2fea: Play The Great Playground Loop to win this sticker!
texts.1b27841f: Not the next stop. Keep flowing!
texts.de8ec4c6: Memory Mode! Every spot has a secret number. Find them all, from one to ten!
texts.d0c6c4c3: Hooray! You did it! You earned the Memory Master badge!
texts.529e358a: Memory Master! You earned this one!
texts.123935eb: Play Memory Mode to win this sticker!
texts.761c6bee: A little bunny is hiding where kids zoom down fast. Head to the tallest slide!
texts.c53a4482: A squirrel is digging for acorns in the sand. Find the sandbox!
texts.f8d2b612: A turtle wants to fly back and forth. Look by the swings!
texts.2e30805d: A hedgehog loves dark, cozy places. Check the crawl tunnel!
texts.c98da479: A frog is trying to hop up the bumpy rocks. Go to the climbing wall!
texts.94e3fd11: An owl is waiting for a picnic snack. Find the picnic bench!
texts.1e6db829: A ladybug is swinging hand over hand. Look under the monkey bars!
texts.a55172e5: A fox is going up and down, up and down. Find the seesaw!
texts.bc26a254: A snail climbed all the way to the top to see far away. Go to the lookout tower!
texts.50ed9979: The last critter, a baby chick, is waiting to go home. Head to the front gate!
texts.5983dd1c: Power station one is at the front gate. Go go go!
texts.393b4a3a: Oh no! The battery ran out. Let's try that one again!
texts.467d4116: Zap! Next power station: the swings!
texts.bb208aec: Lights flickering! Run to the climbing wall!
texts.6d5ebac7: Climb high! Power station at the lookout tower!
texts.8442c034: Next: the monkey bars. Fast feet!
texts.230b4023: Beep beep! Run to the sandbox!
texts.e9b26811: Almost there! Zoom to the crawl tunnel!
texts.f73e3153: Last one! Restore the power at the picnic bench!
texts.66f81669: Go High! Climb to the top of the lookout tower!
texts.f83facc2: Now go Low! Crawl to the tunnel!
texts.84cf8912: High again! Find the climbing wall!
texts.75754ef8: Low! Get down to the sandbox!
texts.a7d633c6: Reach up High to the monkey bars!
texts.276a1b23: Low and slow. Go to the picnic bench!
texts.27325e4c: High! Head to the top of the tallest slide!
texts.ddc00c81: Swing up High! Go to the swings!
texts.f9fe2523: And finally, Low. Walk back to the front gate!
texts.71f9ea9e: Start your loop at the front gate. Keep moving the whole way!
texts.271b0263: Keep walking! Next stop, the tallest slide.
texts.dc5240b9: Nice pace! On to the swings.
